exercises.question: Which sentence correctly uses the subjunctive? [¿Cuál usa correctamente el subjuntivo?]
options: Es necesario que todos respeten la ley. [It is necessary that everyone respect the law.]
Es necesario que todos respetan la ley. [It is necessary that everyone respects the law.]
Es necesario que todos respetar la ley. [It is necessary for everyone to respect the law.]
